newsitem.title: USA: International Home Foods buys Bumble Bee Seafoods.
newsitem.headline: International Home Foods buys Bumble Bee Seafoods.

text.p: International Home Foods Inc. said Tuesday it acquired Bumble Bee Seafoods Inc., a unit of Thailand's Unicord Co. Ltd., for $163 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities.
Bumble Bee filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on May 2 to restructure its debt and facilitate the sale of the company, a spokeswoman for the canned seafood company said.
The agreement to sell the company to International Home, a unit of investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc., came on the same day as the bankruptcy filing, the spokeswoman said.
International Home Foods said in a statement Tuesday that it owns Chef Boyardee canned pastas, Pam cooking spray, Gulden's mustard, Polaner Fruit spreads and other food products.
